test_Lab2dWrapper_instance: test that Lab2dWrapper wraps a dmlab2d.Environment and is an instance of dmlab2d.Environment
test_wrapped_method_delegation: test that Lab2dWrapper delegates all public dmlab2d.Environment methods to the wrapped environment with correct args
test_wrapped_method_return_value: test that Lab2dWrapper returns the wrapped environment method's return value unchanged
run_WrapperTest: run the absltest-based WrapperTest suite to verify Lab2dWrapper delegates all public methods correctly
review_WrapperTest_test_wrapped: review the parameterized test_wrapped method that validates delegation of all public dmlab2d.Environment methods
